key_insight: AgenticDomiKnowS (ADS) lets users describe tasks in natural language and automatically generates correct neuro-symbolic DomiKnowS programs, removing the need to learn library-specific syntax while preserving symbolic constraints.
problem_solved: Bridges the gap between free-form task descriptions and declarative neuro-symbolic programs by automating translation, synthesis, and verification—reducing the time and expertise required to integrate symbolic constraints into deep learning models.
method: Agentic pipeline that uses large language models to translate free-form task descriptions into candidate DomiKnowS programs.
Symbolic validation and execution step that checks generated programs against constraints and test cases, with automated debugging and iterative refinement.
End-to-end synthesis targeting robustness and correctness while preserving declarative semantics of the underlying DomiKnowS framework.
impact: Makes neuro-symbolic programming accessible to practitioners who are not experts in a specific DSL, accelerating adoption of constraint-aware models and enabling more interpretable, data-efficient ML solutions.
